# SegmentGroup

Segmented control for switching a filter or view: items on a recessed bg-muted track, the selected one raised.

`KenosUI.SegmentGroup` · Forms

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.SegmentGroup options={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.SegmentGroup" options="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Segmented control: a filter or view switch with 2–5 options.
